jobs.occupation: Senior CAPEX Project Manager - Industrial Engineering
jobs.description:
Industrial CAPEX project environment

As Project Manager, you take end-to-end responsibility for complex multidisciplinary investment projects within an industrial process setting. You manage the complete lifecycle and remain accountable for scope, budget, timing, quality and safety. The work includes both greenfield developments and major modifications to existing industrial installations.

Key responsibilities

• Manage industrial engineering projects from feasibility and concept definition through to commissioning and final handover to operations.
• Define and control project scope, deliverables, budget, business case, investment approval and the baseline planning in MS Project.
• Drive every project phase, including pre-study, concept selection, basic and detailed engineering, procurement, contractor selection, construction, on-site execution, commissioning and transfer.
• Act as the primary accountable contact for stakeholders and management during the full course of the project.
• Coordinate multidisciplinary internal and external teams covering mechanical, electrical, automation, piping, civil and EHS expertise.
• Manage scope changes, project risks, claims and deviations affecting cost or schedule.
• Report clearly on progress, decisions and issues to steering committees and senior stakeholders.

Technical profile requirements

• You have at least 10 years of experience as a Project Manager, with proven end-to-end ownership of industrial CAPEX projects.
• You also bring at least 7 years of experience as a Project Engineer in disciplines such as mechanical, electrical, piping or civil engineering.
• You have solid experience with pre-feasibility and concept studies, CAPEX budgeting, investment approval processes and the commissioning of industrial installations.
• Experience in the process industry is required.
• You have strong hands-on expertise in MS Project and are used to creating and owning project schedules, not merely following them up.
• You work at academic level and combine strong analytical skills with a broad helicopter view.
Non-technical profile requirements

• You work independently and take full ownership of your assignments.
• You show strong leadership and can challenge stakeholders and contractors when needed.
• You communicate confidently with stakeholders at all organisational levels.
• You bring natural authority in complex industrial environments.
Methodology / certification requirements

• VCA-Vol is mandatory.
• PMP / Prince2 is a plus.
Language proficiencies

• Dutch: Native / Fluent
• English: Fluent

Are you passionate about SAP and eager to work in an innovative IT landscape with first-adopter technologies?

At Joris Ide, SAP plays a key role in supporting and optimising our business processes across Europe. As a SAP FICO Consultant, you contribute to third-line support, system enhancements and end-to-end projects, working closely with both IT and the business. Ready to make an impact? Ide-al!

EOC Group is growing its hotmelt adhesives business (Exomelt), as part of a portfolio of startups and new ventures. We are looking for a hands-on, dynamic Technical Service & Development Specialist to be the technical face of hotmelts to our customers, translating their applications, processes and specifications into the right hotmelt solution, and driving technical business development on the ground.
 

You will need a thorough, practical understanding of hot melt adhesives and some formulation know-how of your own, but you won't be doing deep chemistry alone. You can lean on a team of formulation and chemistry specialists to turn your technical offers into robust products. This is a customer-facing, solution-oriented role for someone who is as comfortable on a customer's production line as in a technical discussion.

 

What will you do?

• You understand customers' applications, processes and specifications in depth, and translate them into the right hotmelt solution and a compelling technical offer.
• You drive technical business development, identifying and pursuing opportunities with new and existing customers in a hands-on, dynamic way.
• Once a solution is proposed, you support customers with in-line application advice, helping them run and troubleshoot hotmelt products on their equipment.
• You act as the technical liaison between customers and EOC's formulation and chemistry specialists, briefing the team on customer requirements and translating technical results back to customers.
• You provide training to agents and distributors who are intensively used to market our products.
• You track technical market trends and innovations in hotmelt adhesives, and bring relevant insights back into EOC's product and technology roadmap.
• You represent EOC and the Hotmelts business at industry conferences and trade shows, building EOC's technical reputation and network in the hotmelt adhesives market.

Who are you? 

• You bring a thorough understanding of hotmelt adhesives (EVA, APAO, rubber-based, polyolefin, or similar hotmelt technologies) and their end-use applications.
• You have working formulation know-how, enough to have credible technical conversations and shape a technical offer, while relying on specialists for detailed formulation work.
• You hold a chemistry degree or equivalent technical qualification (preferred).
• You are hands-on and dynamic, with a genuine drive for technical business development, comfortable owning a customer relationship from technical scoping through to in-line support.
• You communicate and build relationships strongly across customers, internal specialists, and management.
• You are willing and able to travel approximately 50% of the time, mainly shorter trips to customer sites, conferences and trade shows, not extended multi-week travel.
• You have a self-starting mindset suited to a startup environment, comfortable with ambiguity and building processes as the business scales.
You are fluent in English and German; additional European languages are an asset given EOC's customer base.

jobs.description:
About the company

Our client is a well-established player in the logistics and transportation sector, operating across multiple sites and international flows. In a context of strong operational activity, the company is looking to strengthen its accounting team to support its growth and the increasing complexity of its operations.

The company offers a dynamic working environment where responsiveness and accuracy are essential to managing significant and diverse financial flows.

Your role

As a Senior Accountant, you will join an accounting team and play a key role in ensuring the accuracy and reliability of the accounts within a high-volume, multi-site environment.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Managing general accounting and ensuring the accuracy and reliability of the accounts across several entities or sites.
• Participating in monthly and annual closings in a context of high and diverse business volumes.
• Monitoring and analysing operational costs (transportation, fuel, subcontracting) and identifying opportunities for optimisation.
• Performing bank and accounting reconciliations, ensuring the consistency of multi-site financial flows.
• Collaborating with operational teams to ensure reliable and accurate financial information.
• Contributing to the improvement of accounting processes in an industry where speed of execution is key.

Your profile

• You have at least 8 years of solid experience in general accounting, ideally in a high-volume operational environment.
• You hold a Bachelor's degree in Accounting.
• You are fluent in French, English and Dutch, both spoken and written.
• You are detail-oriented and able to maintain an overview while managing a high volume of transactions.
• You are responsive and comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change quickly.
• You enjoy working as part of a team and are comfortable collaborating with operational stakeholders on a daily basis.
